snippet.title: NUTMEG! | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Zip up your tracksuit, grab your clipboard and check your perm in the dressing room mirror, because the nostalgic card-based football management game NUTMEG! is OUT NOW on Steam!

Take over a fourth-division team in the English men’s league and lead them to glory through the ‘80s and ‘90s, managing everything about your team on your journey to the top of the league table. Trade and train players, hire and fire backroom staff, upgrade your stadium, then hit the pitch with your chosen eleven and engage in high-stakes, fast-paced card-based matches to put points on the table. Use your deck to urge on your team from the sidelines, dropping in at key points in the match to take a roll of the dice or nudge the odds in your favour.

NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long!

NUTMEG! is out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590560/NUTMEG_A_Retro_Football_Management_Game/
